name: Music Player
description: Control music from your chat panel. Add a named account, then sign in and start a track in its service window.
skill: Use list_accounts to find the selected account. For playback read get_playback, then use play or pause on that account. If no track is available, open_player and ask the user to start a track. Google sign-in accounts use the same playback tools in their dedicated music browser. Use select_account to switch. To set up a service, use add_account with service and label, optionally login=google for Spotify or YouTube Music, then open_player with signIn=true. Only forget_account after the user confirms removal. Never ask for passwords or sign-in codes.
